name: trace
title: Trace
description: What an agent or a job did, step by step, each a quiet line that opens its detail.
use: The work behind an answer or a run: what an agent thought, searched, read and ran, or the stages of a build. Each step is one line; a step with something behind it is a details element whose summary is the line. Mark the step that is running with aria-busy and say in words why a failed step failed.

instead.when: The events are a record with times, not work in progress, and none opens
It is a fixed sequence the reader moves through
The rows are questions and answers of equal weight
The reader ticks the items off

keyboard.action: On a step that is a details element: opens or closes its detail

platform.fallback: A detail opens and closes at once, without the change of height

classes.name: trace
classes.description: The steps, in a column; a hairline joins their markers

classes.name: trace-step
classes.description: One step, on a details element when it has a detail and on any block when it has none

classes.name: trace-failed
classes.description: A step that failed: its dot or icon and the fact at the end of its line take the danger ink

classes.name: trace-summary
classes.description: The step's line, 32px tall: the marker, the words and a fact at the end. On a summary it is the toggle, with a chevron after the words

classes.name: trace-marker
classes.description: The marker at the start of the line: a dot when empty, or an icon, or a spinner-inline while the step runs

classes.name: trace-meta
classes.description: A fact at the end of the line, in tabular figures: how long it took, how many it found

classes.name: trace-detail
classes.description: What stands behind the step, under the line on the edge of its words

states.name: open
states.description: Set by the browser on a details element: the detail shows and the chevron points down

states.name: running
states.description: The step under way: its words take the strong ink and a bare dot sends out a ring
